farms.label: Farms
farms.description: Register farms, locations and land boundaries.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Manage field size, soil condition and land use.

crops.label: Crop varieties
crops.description: Maintain the crop and variety register.

plantings.label: Plantings
plantings.description: Plan planting, monitor crop stages and preserve field rotation history.

applications.label: Crop applications
applications.description: Record fertilizer, manure and crop protection applications.

scouting.label: Pest & disease
scouting.description: Track scouting, treatments and outbreak severity.

harvests.label: Harvests
harvests.description: Record actual production, losses, quality and stock received.

animals.label: Animals
animals.description: Register livestock, births, identification and mortality.

animal_health.label: Health & vaccinations
animal_health.description: Keep vaccination schedules and veterinary treatment history.

feeding.label: Feed & growth
feeding.description: Track feeding, feed costs and animal growth.

animal_production.label: Livestock production
animal_production.description: Record livestock output and production value.

water_sources.label: Water sources
water_sources.description: Register water sources and available capacity.

irrigation.label: Irrigation schedule
irrigation.description: Schedule irrigation and track water use, operating time and costs.

inventory.label: Inventory
inventory.description: Track inputs and produce with balances calculated from stock movements.

stock_moves.label: Stock movements
stock_moves.description: Record stock additions and usage. Sales, received purchases and linked harvests also affect balances.

equipment.label: Equipment
equipment.description: Track machinery, allocation and straight-line depreciation.

maintenance.label: Maintenance & fuel
maintenance.description: Record equipment service, repairs, fuel and operating costs.

storage_lots.label: Storage lots
storage_lots.description: Track storage duration, quality and dispatch. Record stock adjustments separately to avoid double counting.

employees.label: Employees
employees.description: Manage farm workers, roles and pay rates.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.description: Allocate daily work and monitor progress and productivity.

attendance.label: Attendance
attendance.description: Record attendance and earned pay for payroll export.

suppliers.label: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Keep supplier contacts, performance and agreements.

purchases.label: Procurement
purchases.description: Approve purchases and receive stock. Only received orders increase inventory.

customers.label: Customers
customers.description: Manage buyers, market destinations and contract terms.

sales.label: Sales & invoices
sales.description: Issue printable invoices and record sales. Confirmed invoices reduce stock.

payments.label: Payments
payments.description: Track actual income and expenditure. Invoice totals and cash flow are reported separately.

budgets.label: Budgets
budgets.description: Compare planned spending with recorded cash expenditure.

loans.label: Loans
loans.description: Track borrowing, principal repayments and due dates.

market_prices.label: Market prices
market_prices.description: Record sourced market prices and compare price and demand trends.

weather_logs.label: Weather records
weather_logs.description: Keep local rainfall and environmental history alongside live forecasts.
